jobs.title: Manager, Climate Environmental Prediction Services
jobs.description:
Australia is increasingly affected by climate change, creating a growing need for climate analysis and forecasting services to support community safety and resilience.

To meet this need, the Community Services Group (CSG) delivers customer-focused, integrated and resilient operational services across Australia. CSG comprises Environmental Prediction Services (EPS), Decision Support Services (DSS) and National Production Services (NPS), enabling the delivery of a wide range of products and services that provide significant value to the Australian community.

The Manager Climate Environmental Prediction Services sits within the Community Services Group. The successful candidate will have a unique opportunity to lead the bureau's climate service capability and provide critical direction to a team of climate experts as part of the bureau's national operation.

The Manager Climate Environmental Prediction Services will lead multidisciplinary teams to deliver consistent high-quality climate related environmental prediction products and support the bureau's decision support services to deliver tailored advice to decision makers and customers in Industry, Government, Emergency Management and the Australian Community. They will drive innovation and scientific excellence to deliver impact-based services and put customers and their needs at the centre of bureau operations.

jobs.description:

118675

Advertised Salary

Pay Basis
Monthly

Job Description

The Wildlife Ecology Laboratory ( WEL )
at Tennessee State University ( TSU )
is seeking a post-doctoral research associate to utilize environmental DNA as an early screening tool for aquatic invasive species in National Forests throughout the southeast United States. In addition to refining molecular approaches to screen for aquatic invasive species, the project will aim to compare eDNA screening approaches to traditional aquatic survey methods. The postdoc will work collaboratively with researchers from the USDA Forest Service Southern Research Station and Clemson University and will be expected to lead research efforts related to sample processing and post-processing of genome-scale bioinformatics data. The successful candidate will be expected to assist with mentoring graduate and undergraduate students in the WEL . In addition to the primary project responsibilities, there will be opportunities to assist with other ongoing wildlife research projects.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD in a relevant field and have a demonstrated record of peer-reviewed publications, including at least one first author publication. Required skillsets include effective writing and quantitative skills, and prior experience with molecular approaches, including quantitative PCR , metabarcoding, and post-processing of genome-scale bioinformatics data. Other preferred skillsets include proficiency with the R statistical analysis platform and prior experience with occupancy and species distribution models.

Special Instructions to Applicants

Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a criminal background check as mandated by Tennessee State University.

Official transcripts for positions which require a post-secondary undergraduate degree, advanced degree and/or certification must be presented upon hire.

An unofficial transcript may be attached in the “Transcript” section.

You will be required to provide names and contact information for three references during your application to the posting. If you are the recommended candidate for the position, our online hiring system will automatically generate solicitation for these letters using contact information you provided.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) Specialist
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our team at Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), is united by a commitment to collaboration and scientific excellence, building on a strong foundation of innovation, expertise, and reliability. Guided by our vision to help researchers rapidly move from the lab to life-changing advances, we work closely with global partners to accelerate progress and genomics breakthroughs across fields like cancer, infectious disease, rare genetic disorders, and more. At IDT, you’ll be part of a culture rooted in continuous learning and improvement—where your growth fuels our mission to accelerate the pace of genomics and helps shape a healthier, brighter future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior EHS Specialist
is responsible for is responsible for oversight and implementation of all Environmental Health, Safety and related regulatory requirements to ensure compliance, identify & resolve EHS gaps, and reduce risks.

This position reports to the Global EHS Manager, is part of the Global EHS team, and works onsite at the IDT location in Sunnyvale, CA.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead the EHS function for a combined manufacturing, laboratory, warehouse, and R & D site
Lead and implement EHS Management System program activities such as EHS Program evaluations, compliance audits, corrective action plans, facilitating onboarding and ongoing training for associates.
Lead risk assessments, safety observations, incident investigations, inspections, and corrective actions using DBS problem-solving tools to identify hazards, reduce risk, and strengthen a proactive safety culture.
Manage environmental permits, regulatory reporting, and compliance requirements
Monitor and maintain EHS performance, including tracking key performance indicators, trends and emerging regulations

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor's degree required.
At least three years of experience including experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, or other regulated operations, with a working knowledge of applicable Cal/OSHA, EPA, RCRA, and related regulatory requirements.
Demonstrated experience conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action management to drive risk reduction and continuous improvement.
Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to influence and engage associates and leaders at all levels while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

Ability to travel as required (up to 5%, including overnight stays)
Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 50lbs

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Associate Safety Professional (ASP), Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM)
Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response (HAZWOPER) first responder operations level
Experience with Danaher Business System (DBS) or equivalent continuous improvement methodologies.

IDT, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

The annual salary range for this role is $83,000-$100,000 . This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.
